a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan would almost certainly kill us both before the reserve reaches 8. So I intend to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If we survive past round 1, I will keep operating the generator with you every round until you have your 4, and I won't take anything more. If you also take, the split is random and we'll likely both fall short, so please consider operating.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
